name: Structural mechanism generator
role: Generate target and covariate histories plus paired future worlds with shared innovations
output_format: factual and intervened arrays plus oracle response
notes: Validate with exact replay and determinism tests

name: Matched intervention constructor
role: Perturb exactly one known-future covariate while holding history and other inputs fixed
input_format: factual future covariates and intervention config
output_format: intervened future covariates and active mask
notes: Assert the changed column and intervention support

name: Frozen model adapter
role: Map the common audit batch into each public model API without tuning
notes: Validate shapes revisions and absence of fitting

name: Target-only comparator
role: Invoke the same frozen backbone without future covariates
notes: Use identical series horizon and quantiles

name: Paired response extractor
role: Subtract factual forecasts from intervention forecasts for the same series

name: Directional Sign Agreement
role: Measure sign correctness only on predeclared oracle-active horizons
input_format: predicted and oracle responses plus support threshold
notes: Test oracle zero sign-flip and scale fixtures

name: Response Gain Ratio
role: Measure total predicted response magnitude relative to oracle magnitude
notes: Test oracle under-gain and over-gain fixtures

name: Normalized Response Error
role: Measure L1 response error normalized by oracle effect magnitude
notes: Test oracle scale and offset fixtures

name: Temporal Localization Score
role: Compare L1-normalized absolute response profiles across the horizon
notes: Test oracle zero and lag-shift fixtures

name: Placebo Response Ratio
role: Normalize response to an irrelevant covariate by the matched active oracle response
input_format: placebo predicted response and matched active oracle response
notes: Test zero leakage and spurious-response fixtures

name: Series-cluster bootstrap
role: Preserve horizon dependence by resampling whole paired series within generator seeds
output_format: cell estimates and percentile confidence intervals
notes: Test deterministic sampling and synthetic coverage

name: Frozen continuation gate
role: Apply direction gain placebo and complementary-accuracy rules without result-dependent edits
output_format: continue or stop decision with reasons
notes: Test boundary values and immutable config hashing
